description.value: Matcha Corner is a specialty dessert shop on Kingsway in Vancouver, offering matcha ice cream, ceremonial-grade matcha powder, hojicha powder, and the currently trending Dubai Chewy Cookie. The shop also sells retail matcha products and handles catering and events bookings. It sits on the busy Kingsway corridor, making it a convenient sweet stop for cyclists passing through this part of Vancouver.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 35m; stands (2 spaces) at 36m; stands at 47m; wall_loops (5 spaces) at 90m. Total: 9 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at matchacorner.square.site confirms the physical address as 1150 Kingsway Vancouver BC V5V 3C9, matching the OSM record. The site is branded as '66 Dessert | Matcha Corner' — a name discrepancy worth flagging. The shop sells matcha ice cream, Dubai Chewy Cookies, matcha powder, and offers catering; online ordering via Square is present, supporting a takeout inference. No amenity details (bike parking, Wi-Fi, washrooms, water refill) are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: Website branding is '66 Dessert | Matcha Corner' while OSM lists only 'Matcha Corner' — the business may operate under a combined or dual name not reflected in OSM.
No phone number in OSM or on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating business with confirmed physical address and active website; a legitimate café/dessert stop on Kingsway useful to touring cyclists.
